security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly a routing and documentation guide for Convex work. Two findings are confirmed because the skill recommends an external npx command that can modify project files; the remaining Markdown backtick and documentation-link findings are false positives or low-impact references. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious routing behavior.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends running npx convex ai-files install.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the command, and explain that it may download packages and modify project guidance files.

remediation.issue: The skill links to external Convex guidance and fallback rules.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the links scoped to trusted Convex domains and ask users to review remote rule content before copying it into a project.

static_findings.snippet: Prefer `npx convex ai-files install` over copying rules by hand when possible.

content.user_title: Route Convex Tasks to the Right Skill
content.value_statement: Convex requests can be broad, and teams may choose the wrong workflow. This skill directs Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward setup guidance and specialized Convex skills.
actual_capabilities: Routes broad Convex requests to a more specific Convex workflow skill.
Recommends installing or refreshing managed Convex AI guidance before deeper work.
Points users to official Convex AI documentation for current setup guidance.
Identifies when quickstart, authentication, component, migration, or performance skills fit better.
Defines when this routing skill should not be used.
limitations: Does not implement Convex code changes by itself.
Depends on separate Convex skills for detailed workflows.
Requires user review before running external setup commands.
Does not verify whether remote Convex guidance has changed.

use_cases.title: Choose a Convex Workflow
use_cases.description: Identify the right Convex skill before starting setup, authentication, migration, or performance work.

use_cases.title: Refresh Project Guidance
use_cases.description: Check whether a repository should install or refresh managed Convex AI guidance before feature work.

use_cases.title: Triage Broad Requests
use_cases.description: Turn an underspecified Convex task into a clear next step for an AI coding assistant.

prompt_templates.title: Pick a Starting Point
prompt_templates.prompt: I need help with a Convex app. Decide which Convex workflow skill fits best and tell me the first safe step.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner routing for a broad Convex request

prompt_templates.title: Add Convex to a Project
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to add Convex to an existing app. Check whether project guidance should be refreshed, then route me to the right skill.
prompt_templates.scenario: New Convex setup in an existing repository

prompt_templates.title: Select a Specialized Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: My Convex task may involve authentication, components, migration, or performance. Ask any needed questions, then choose the specific workflow skill.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Multi-Step Convex Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Convex goal, identify which specialized skills apply in sequence, and explain when to switch between them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across several Convex workflows

output_examples.input: I need to add Convex auth to my app.
output_examples.output: Use the authentication setup workflow. First confirm the project has current Convex AI guidance, then proceed with the auth-specific skill.

output_examples.input: My Convex queries are slow and I am unsure where to start.
output_examples.output: Route this to the performance audit workflow. It is a better match than the general Convex routing skill.

output_examples.input: I am starting a new Convex project.
output_examples.output: Start with the quickstart workflow. Refresh managed Convex guidance first if the repository does not already include it.

best_practices: Use this skill only when the Convex request is broad or underspecified.
Confirm with the user before running any external setup command.
Switch to the most specific Convex skill as soon as the task is clear.
anti_patterns: Do not stay in this routing skill after a specialized workflow clearly applies.
Do not copy remote guidance into a repository without user review.
Do not treat this skill as a replacement for project-specific Convex implementation work.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It routes broad Convex requests to setup guidance or a more specific Convex workflow skill.

faq.question: Does it write Convex application code?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose the right workflow, then other Convex skills handle detailed implementation.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when the request mentions Convex but the exact workflow is unclear.

faq.question: When should I avoid it?
faq.answer: Avoid it when the user already asks for a specific Convex quickstart, auth, migration, component, or performance task.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: It links to Convex documentation and guidance, but it does not fetch content automatically.

faq.question: Is command execution required?
faq.answer: No. It recommends a Convex setup command, but execution should require explicit user confirmation.
